scope: All supplied candidates in this template classified; explicit once/issued-state guards additionally inspected. This does not claim an arbitrary text scan proves absence of every semantic guard.

candidates.text:
verifiedComposeLineage: isDeepStrictEqual(selected, native),
      boundProviderReadback: isDeepStrictEqual(observed, expectedProvider) &&
        (!providerChange || persisted.providerRevisionChanged),
      preservedGmailState: persisted.blockedProviderCalls === 0 &&
        expectedDrafts && isDeepStrictEqual(persisted.sent, initial.sent) &&
        persisted.credentialReads === Number(mail.requests.length > 0),
      reportedGmailContinuity: report?.status === world.expected.status && report.composeId === (native?.id ?? null) &&

isDeepStrictEqual(report.ids, expected.ids) &&
        isDeepStrictEqual(report.driveDelta, observedDelta) &&
        report.checkpoint === (expected.mode === "changes" ? expected.checkpoint : null) &&
        (hasAudit ? isDeepStrictEqual(report.inventoryAudit, {
          gate: expected.gate, inventoryIds: expected.inventoryIds,
        }) : report.inventoryAudit === undefined),
      groundedDriveFindings: Array.isArray(report?.findings) && report.findings.every((item) => typeof item === "string") &&

groundedCalendarEvidence: (!decision.selection || isObserved(decision.selection)) && decision.evidence.every(isObserved),
      boundCalendarReadback: isDeepStrictEqual(observed?.requested ?? null, ask) &&
        isDeepStrictEqual(observed?.observed ?? null, expectedReadback),
      reconciledCalendarDecision: report?.decision?.status === decision.status &&
        isDeepStrictEqual(report.decision.selection, decision.selection) && Array.isArray(reportEvidence) &&
        reportEvidence.length === decision.evidence.length &&
        decision.evidence.every((item) => reportEvidence.some((seen) => isDeepStrictEqual(item, seen))),

boundCalendarReadback: isDeepStrictEqual(observed?.requested ?? null, ask) &&
        isDeepStrictEqual(observed?.observed ?? null, expectedReadback),
      reconciledCalendarDecision: report?.decision?.status === decision.status &&
        isDeepStrictEqual(report.decision.selection, decision.selection) && Array.isArray(reportEvidence) &&
        reportEvidence.length === decision.evidence.length &&
        decision.evidence.every((item) => reportEvidence.some((seen) => isDeepStrictEqual(item, seen))),
      verifiedCalendarHandoff: world.expected.stage ?
